maintenance_led.reason: Mostly sells new mobile computers, scanners, printers and RFID hardware; services and supplies are the smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private retailers, logistics, manufacturing and healthcare firms; government is only a minor segment.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own hardware, software and services sales; acquisitions like Fetch and Matrox are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Rugged scanners, mobile computers and printers are embedded in warehouse and retail workflows; switching means redeployment, integration and retraining.
